(Currently amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced no more than sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced exactly sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through at least one opening defined in the housing of the cooling system.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable.  

(Currently amended) Claim 13: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall specifically designed to accommodate the cooling system.

(Currently amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill, wherein the mounting elements include at least one bracket configured for securing the housing between the studs of the wall. 

(Currently amended) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall, the housing containing an evaporative cooling system that cools an indoor area. 

(Currently amended) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes a set of supports for installation between wall studs spaced no more than sixteen inches on center.
